Control Objective: Protect the cardholder data environment using network security controls
Current State: Firewalls are deployed but rule reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Firewall configuration and rule review records
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly firewall rule reviews and document changes

Control Objective: Remove or disable default accounts and insecure settings
Current State: Default accounts are removed and hardened configurations are used
Evidence Expected: Configuration standards and system hardening evidence

Control Objective: Limit storage and protect retained cardholder data
Current State: Retention requirements exist but are not consistently reviewed
Evidence Expected: Data retention policy and deletion records
Recommended Action: Define retention periods and verify unnecessary cardholder data is securely deleted

Control Objective: Encrypt payment data transmitted over public networks
Current State: Secure encryption is used for payment traffic
Evidence Expected: TLS configuration and network security documentation

Current State: Endpoint protection is deployed across critical systems

Control Objective: Remediate vulnerabilities and maintain secure systems
Current State: Vulnerability scanning is performed but some critical remediation exceeds target timelines
Recommended Action: Define and enforce severity-based remediation timelines

Control Objective: Restrict access based on business need
Current State: Role-based access controls exist but periodic reviews are inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Access review reports and approval records
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions

Control Objective: Protect administrative and remote access using strong authentication
Current State: MFA is enabled for some administrators but not all
Recommended Action: Require MFA for all administrator and remote access accounts

Control Objective: Restrict physical access to systems and media
Current State: Cloud-hosted environment limits direct physical control
Recommended Action: Review cloud provider physical security attestations

Control Objective: Log and monitor access to systems and cardholder data
Current State: Centralized logging is enabled but daily review evidence is incomplete
Evidence Expected: SIEM screenshots and log review records
Recommended Action: Document daily log reviews and retain investigation evidence

Control Objective: Regularly test security systems and processes
Current State: Vulnerability scanning occurs but penetration testing is inconsistent
Evidence Expected: Penetration test reports and scan results
Recommended Action: Perform recurring penetration testing and track findings to closure

Control Objective: Maintain security policies training and incident response procedures
Current State: Policies and security training exist but incident response testing is incomplete
Evidence Expected: Security policies training records and tabletop exercise reports
Recommended Action: Conduct annual incident response tabletop exercises and document lessons learned

Current State: Third-party payment providers are used but recurring reviews are inconsistent
Recommended Action: Perform annual security reassessments of critical service providers

Control Objective: Train personnel on payment security responsibilities
Current State: Recurring security awareness training is provided
Recommended Action: Continue annual training and phishing simulations

Control Objective: Maintain and test incident response procedures
Current State: An incident response plan exists but recent testing evidence is unavailable
Evidence Expected: Incident response plan and tabletop exercise report
Recommended Action: Conduct a formal annual incident response exercise
